title: Security: premium gate enforcement hardening + wording fixes
changes: Fixed: members could open and submit applications (Appys) even after a server's premium subscription lapsed
Fixed: application types could be created, edited, or deleted via direct API calls without a premium subscription
Fixed: application panel could be sent via direct API call without a premium subscription
Fixed: AI Dispatch reload endpoint was accessible without a premium subscription check
Fixed: Blacklist panel send endpoint lacked a premium check, inconsistent with the /blacklist and /removeblacklist commands
Fixed: Applications feature was described as 'staff application panels' everywhere — updated to 'custom application panels for any purpose' across all commands, dashboard, and landing page
